from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u040/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[-1]) if value == 5]
    for c in markers:
        anchors = [(r, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        # Each anchor paints upward to the preceding anchor; the top anchor
        # continues to the top edge.
        lower_r, lower_color = anchors[-1]
        for r in range(lower_r + 1, h):
            out[r][c] = lower_color
        for i in range(len(anchors) - 1, 0, -1):
            r, color = anchors[i]
            upper_r = anchors[i - 1][0]
            for rr in range(upper_r + 1, r):
                out[rr][c] = color
        top_r, top_color = anchors[0]
        for r in range(top_r):
            out[r][c] = top_color
    return out
'''
p=program_dir/'task-5b8e98f4.py'
p.write_text(code)
